notes.title: Update from 11/11/2024
notes.notes:
Now, the bonus from upgrades is multiplied by 4 for every 5, 10, 20, 30... and so on, upgrade purchases.
Added the ability to buy 5% of the resources needed for prestige for 100% of the emeralds required for prestige.
A minor bug with perks has been fixed.
P.S. If you have purchased some click or passive income upgrades, the multipliers for purchasing 5, 10, 20, etc., upgrades will not be recalculated automatically. You will only see the upgrades after prestige.

notes.title: Update November 8, 2024
notes.notes:
Added data backup.
The bonuses of perks that give a chance of dropping 1000 books and papyri have been increased. (In the later stages of the game, books and papyri became easier to obtain)
Added the ability to restart the game.
After 9 prestige, you receive 100 prestige cores for every 100q (previously it was 1q)
